newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - HRW wheat, soy up, corn weakens.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - HRW wheat, soy up, corn weakens.

text.p: CHICAGO, Sept 10 - FOB Gulf basis values for hard red winter wheat and soybeans were mostly higher on Tuesday while corn values slumped.

Several grain dealers and agronomists noted that early harvested corn in Illinois and Indiana contained high moisture, kernel damage and debris, resulting in farmers being penalized when the grain was sold.
Also, the market will be waiting for Wednesday's crop production report as well as scanning the weather forecasts in the next few days for any early frost indications.

Mexico overnight bought 18,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat slated for October delivery, U.S. exporters said. Half of the shipment was for $190 a tonne and the other half was for $198.00 a tonne via rail.

South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Tuesday it bought 53,000 tonnes of Argentine feed corn at $162.90 per tonne, C&F. Shipment arrival was set for June 20 to Inchon.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
